component.name: Pulse
component.summary: Web-first chat, voice and high-quality screen streaming

description.p: Pulse is a Discord-like chat, voice and streaming client. The desktop app is a thin Electron shell over the web app at pulse.unicutmedia.com; on Linux it adds high-quality, GPU-encoded screen streaming via a bundled gpu-screen-recorder.
First packaged build: Electron shell loading the deployed web app, plus the local GSR streaming bridge.
